name: QuizFubu – Lead Generation Quizzes
author: arshadthaheem

sections.description:
QuizFubu is a powerful, lightweight tool designed for marketers, business owners, and agencies who want to turn website visitors into qualified leads. No tracking, no external data collection, and no ads.

Create interactive quizzes that engage visitors, calculate scores in real time, and display personalized results — all without writing a single line of code.

Whether you are a coach, a consultant, a real estate agent, or an eCommerce store owner, QuizFubu lets you create customized quiz journeys that convert. Based on the user’s answers, the plugin calculates a real-time score and displays a tailored result page unique to each visitor.

How It Works

  1. Build your quiz questions and assign a score to each answer option.
  2. Define result rules, set a score range and write a custom message for each outcome.
  3. Embed the quiz anywhere using the shortcode [quizfubu_quiz].
  4. Engage visitors with personalized quiz experiences.

Core Features (Free)

  • Dynamic Scoring Engine – Assign different point values to each answer. The plugin calculates a cumulative score and matches it to the correct result rule automatically.
  • Custom Result Pages – Define multiple score ranges and display a unique message, badge, and personalized feedback for each outcome.
  • Insight Cards – Display beautifully designed recommendation cards below the quiz result, personalized per score range. Each card has an emoji, heading, and description, giving users a deeper, more engaging result experience.
  • Progress Bar & Step Counter – Keep users engaged with a real-time progress indicator showing how far along they are in the quiz.
  • Fully Responsive Design – Quizzes look great on mobile, tablet, and desktop without any extra configuration.
  • Simple Shortcode Embed – Place your quiz on any page, post, or widget area using [quizfubu_quiz].
  • Lightweight & Fast – Clean, optimized code with no bloat. Built with lightweight, performance-optimized code for WordPress websites.
  • No External Services Required – The free version works independently without requiring third-party services or external APIs. Everything runs on your own server.

Pro Version

Unlock the full power of QuizFubu with the Pro Add-on.

  • Lead Gating – Lock result cards until the visitor submits their name and email. Turn every quiz completion into a captured lead.
  • Leads Database – Every submission saved to your WordPress database with name, email, score, device, referrer, duration, and conversion status.
  • Advanced Filtering & CSV Export – Filter leads by quiz, status, date range, and score range. Export any filtered view as CSV.
  • Analytics Dashboard – Built-in analytics with completion stats, conversion rate, activity charts, score distribution, conversion funnel, and top referrers, filterable by quiz and time period.
  • Multiple Quiz Manager – Create and manage unlimited quiz funnels with individual settings and webhook URLs.
  • Multiple Quizzes Support – Create and manage multiple quiz funnels. Each quiz gets its own unique shortcode like [quizfubu_quiz id="1"].
  • Multiple Quizzes on Same Page – Embed two or more different quizzes on the same page, each runs independently without conflicts.
  • Elementor Widget – Drag and drop the quiz directly inside Elementor. No shortcode needed.
  • Webhook Integration – Send lead data to Make, Zapier, n8n, or any webhook URL on form submission.
  • Abandoned Lead Capture – Saves quiz completions even without form submission so you never lose data.
  • Universal Form Support – Works with Elementor, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms, and Fluent Forms.

Get QuizFubu Pro →

Use Cases

  • Coaches & Consultants – “What type of client are you?” quizzes that qualify leads before a discovery call.
  • eCommerce Stores – “Find your perfect product” quizzes that recommend items based on answers.
  • Health & Wellness – Score-based health assessment quizzes that gate personalized advice behind a lead form.
  • Real Estate – “What type of home buyer are you?” quizzes that segment leads by readiness and budget.
  • Agencies – Create quiz funnels for multiple client projects across any industry.

Privacy

QuizFubu does not collect any data from your website visitors on its own. The free version stores no personal information. The Pro version stores lead data (name, email, score, device type, referrer) in your own WordPress database only. The free version does not send data to external servers. In the Pro version, external data transmission only occurs when webhook integrations are explicitly configured by the site owner.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the quizfubu-lead-generation-quizzes folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Quiz Funnel in your WordPress dashboard sidebar.
  4. Add your quiz questions, assign scores to each answer option, and define your result rules.
  5. Copy the shortcode [quizfubu_quiz] and paste it onto any page or post where you want the quiz to appear.
  6. Visit that page to see your quiz live.
sections.faq:
Do I need to know how to code?

No. QuizFubu is fully no-code. You build everything from the WordPress admin dashboard and embed with a single shortcode.

How does the scoring work?

Each answer option has a point value you define. When a visitor completes the quiz, all points are added up. You set score ranges (e.g. 0–30, 31–60, 61–100) and each range displays a different result message.

Can I create personality quizzes?

Yes. By assigning scores to different answers, you can categorize users into distinct result buckets, making it easy to build personality quizzes, readiness assessments, product finders, and more.

Can I embed multiple quizzes on the same page?

Yes. The Pro version allows multiple quiz funnels using unique shortcodes like [quizfubu_quiz id=”1″] and [quizfubu_quiz id=”2″]. Each quiz runs independently without conflicts.

Does it work with Elementor?

Yes. The free version works via the [quizfubu_quiz] shortcode, which can be placed inside any Elementor Text Editor or Shortcode widget. The Pro version includes a dedicated Elementor Widget for full drag-and-drop placement inside the Elementor editor.

Can I capture leads with the free version?

The free version supports shortcode embedding and can be paired with any contact form plugin placed on the same page. The Pro version adds native lead gating, it locks result cards until the visitor submits a form, and saves every lead automatically to your WordPress database.

How many questions can I add?

You can create quizzes with as many questions and answer options as needed.

Can I show different results to different users?

Yes. You define result rules based on score ranges. Each range can have its own badge, custom message, and personalized insight cards.

Is the plugin GDPR friendly?

The free version stores no personal data. The Pro version stores lead data only in your own WordPress database, no data leaves your server. You are responsible for disclosing data collection to your users in accordance with your local privacy laws.

Will this slow down my website?

The plugin only loads its scripts on pages where the [quizfubu_quiz] shortcode is present. It uses lightweight and optimized JavaScript with no external API calls in the free version.

Where can I get the Pro version?

Visit arshadthaheem.com/quiz-funnel-builder to learn more and purchase the Pro add-on.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Core quiz engine with dynamic scoring logic.
  • Multiple result rules based on score ranges with badge, custom message, and insight cards per range.
  • Progress bar and step counter.
  • Insight cards: personalized result cards per score range with emoji, title, description.
  • Admin dashboard for managing questions, answer options, scores, and result rules.
  • Shortcode [quizfubu_quiz] for embedding on any page or post.
  • Pro version information included in admin sidebar and plugin action links.
